name: Sales Return Report - Detail
query:
SELECT
    dn.name AS 'SR No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(dn.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Date',
    dn.customer_name AS 'Customer Name',
    st.sales_person AS 'Salesman',
    dn.return_against AS 'Return Against DO No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(dn_orig.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Return Against Date',
    dni.item_name AS 'Item Name:Item Name:100',
    dni.qty AS 'Qty:Float:',
    dni.uom AS 'UOM',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    dni.rate AS 'Price:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.discount_amount AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    dni.amount AS 'Amount:Currency/ccy:'
FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn
LEFT JOIN
    `tabDelivery Note Item` AS dni ON dni.parent = dn.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSales Team` AS st ON st.parent = dn.name
-- JOIN TAMBAHAN: Bergabung ke tabel DN itu sendiri untuk mengambil tanggal DO asli
LEFT JOIN
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn_orig ON dn_orig.name = dn.return_against
WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND dn.is_return = 1 -- Kueri ini hanya menampilkan DN Retur
ORDER BY
    dn.posting_date ASC;
